messages:
Maya: Quick kickoff for cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for artifacts, legal, publisher access, and marketing assets. Target: baseline listings in one week.
Tom: I'll handle AMI and container bakes. Need publisher CI creds and SKU pattern. Suggest RW-<CLOUD>-INFER-v1.
Sam: Creating pub-ci role and requesting publisher invites today. Will share access once done.
Lina: Legal checklist: MSA pointer, localized EULA (EN/FR/DE), privacy blurb (DPA notes for EU), and 3rd-party attributions if any.
Jorge: Telemetry must be opt-in for trial images and strip PII. Proposed retention 30 days.
Marcy: Marketing needs one-line blurb, 3 screenshots, and SVG logo. Will draft once manifest is uploaded.
Maya: Minimal manifest example posted in tracker (offer_name, sku, cloud, artifact links, trial days, legal links). Use that across clouds.
deploy-bot: Publisher invite sent to tom@redwood.com and maya@redwood.com for AWS.
Tom: Starting AMI bake tomorrow morning; will push multi-arch container images and post artifact locations here.
Maya: Owners: Tom (artifacts), Sam (publisher/CI), Lina (legal), Jorge (telemetry), Marcy (marketing). I'll create the tracker and assign tasks. Thanks! :raised_hands:
